description.value:
The very sight of the Militech Crusher is enough to bring a tear to any gun lover's eye. This powerful shotgun, designed for short-range combat, was first created in the year 2020, soon becoming one of the period's most iconic weapons. The version currently available on the market has seen some updates from the original - including a new, modern sight - but its distinctive look remains the same. Once standard-issue among corporate guards, today the Crusher is popular among mercs with a nostalgic streak.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Shotgun • Skill: Handgun • Range: Short Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: None

Range: Short Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
